name: acme
description: Internal catalog of AI artifacts: skills, agents, MCP servers, and hooks shared across the company.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review a pull request or working-tree diff against the company engineering standards, reporting correctness bugs, missing tests, and security issues with file and line references. Use before requesting human review on any change.

plugins.name: dbt-helper
plugins.description: Write and review dbt models following the data team's layering and naming conventions, including tests and documentation for every new model. Use when adding or changing a model in the analytics repository.

plugins.name: deploy-kit
plugins.description: Prepare and verify a service deployment: check the release checklist, confirm migrations are backward compatible, and produce the rollout and rollback plan. Use when shipping a backend service to staging or production.

plugins.name: format-guard
plugins.description: Run the repository's own formatter after the assistant edits a file, and only in repositories that already declare one. Use it to keep generated edits consistent with the project's existing formatting rules.

plugins.name: incident-comms
plugins.description: Draft customer-facing incident updates in the company's voice: what is affected, what is being done, and when the next update comes. Use while an incident is open and customers need to be told something.

plugins.name: pack-backend
plugins.description: Standard artifact set for backend engineers: code review plus the deployment workflow. Install this when you join a backend team.

plugins.name: pack-onboarding
plugins.description: The baseline set of AI artifacts every engineer at the company gets by default. Install this first; team-specific packs build on top of it.

plugins.name: runbook-search
plugins.description: Find and apply the company's operational runbooks during an incident, using the internal runbook MCP server. Use when a service is degraded and you need the documented procedure rather than an improvised one.

plugins.name: sql-lint
plugins.description: Check raw SQL against the data team's naming and formatting conventions. Superseded by dbt-helper, which covers the same conventions plus tests and documentation for the models the SQL belongs to.
